title: Add Distributor Delivery Data (Admin → Distributor Panel) and Fix Add Store Map

requirements.text: Add a 'Distributor Delivery Data' management section in the Admin panel. Admin can create, edit, and delete distributor delivery records. Each record stores: Order ID (linked to an existing order), Truck Number, Driver Name, Driver Contact Number, Distributor (linked user with 'distributor' role), Estimated Delivery Date/Time, and any additional Notes. The backend must persist these records and expose query functions to list all records (admin) and filter by distributor user (distributor role).

quotes: in admin panel there is a option of add distibutor delivery data
and as they fill its show in distibutor panel

acceptanceCriteria: Admin panel has an 'Add Distributor Delivery Data' form with fields: Order ID (dropdown or searchable from existing orders), Truck Number, Driver Name, Driver Contact Number, Distributor (dropdown of users with distributor role), Estimated Delivery Date/Time, and Notes.
Admin can add, edit, and delete distributor delivery records from a dedicated table/list.
Backend stores distributor delivery records in a stable map and enforces that only admins can create/update/delete them.
A query function returns distributor delivery records filtered by the logged-in distributor's user ID so each distributor only sees their own assignments.
The distributor delivery record is linked to an order and displays: Order ID, Truck Number, Driver Name, Driver Contact, Estimated Delivery Date/Time, and current order status.

requirements.text: Create a Distributor portal/panel (accessible only to users with the 'distributor' role) that displays all distributor delivery records assigned to the logged-in distributor. Each card/row shows: Order ID, linked Store Name, Truck Number, Driver Name, Driver Contact Number, Estimated Delivery Date/Time, and current Order Status. The distributor can mark an order as 'Truck Arrived' once they have received the delivery at their location. The panel must be mobile-responsive.

quotes: as they fill its show in distibutor panel
after they get the delivery at there location they mark as truck arrived

acceptanceCriteria: A dedicated Distributor Dashboard page is accessible only when the logged-in user has the 'distributor' role; other roles are redirected.
The page fetches distributor delivery records assigned to the current distributor and renders them as cards or table rows.
Each entry displays: Order ID, Store Name, Truck Number, Driver Name, Driver Contact, Estimated Delivery Date/Time, and Order Status badge.
Each entry has a 'Mark Truck Arrived' button that, when clicked, updates the distributor delivery record status to 'Truck Arrived' in the backend; the button is disabled/hidden after already marked.
The layout is fully responsive and optimized for mobile screens.
The Distributor role is added to sidebar navigation so that Distributor users only see the Distributor Dashboard nav item.

requirements.text: Fix the 'Add Store' and 'Edit Store' map functionality in StoreManagementPage.tsx. The map preview and coordinate display must correctly render using the browser Geolocation API for 'Use Current Location', and the manual coordinate input fields (Latitude, Longitude) must be editable and kept in sync with the map display. Remove any dependency on external map tile providers that may be blocked or broken; use an OpenStreetMap iframe embed or a plain coordinate display with a Leaflet/static map fallback so the map always renders without errors.

quotes: there is a issue in add store with map please resolve this

acceptanceCriteria: Opening the Add Store or Edit Store dialog no longer shows a broken/blank map area or console errors related to the map.
The 'Use Current Location' button successfully requests the browser geolocation, then populates the Latitude and Longitude fields and updates the map preview accordingly.
Manual edits to the Latitude and Longitude input fields update the map preview in real time.
The map embed or coordinate display renders correctly in all modern browsers without relying on any API key or blocked external service.
Store save/update works correctly after using the location picker.

constraints: Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or any files under frontend/src/components/ui.
All backend logic must remain in the single actor in backend/main.mo.
Distributor delivery records must be stored in a stable backend data structure with appropriate role-based access control.
The 'Mark Truck Arrived' action must be validated server-side to ensure only the assigned distributor can trigger it.
nonGoals: Barcode scanning and truck-loaded/unloaded image upload for the distributor (deferred to a separate request).
Real-time WebSocket push updates between admin and distributor panels.
Changing the existing 4-stage QR delivery workflow for other roles.
Any financial or profit reporting module.
Changing the existing order approval or QR code generation logic.
